mines.mine_notes: Exploration-stage issuer; processing of previously placed leach-pad ore completed Dec 2022, no significant revenue until mining resumes. ~64,000 acres of claims. 2026 Hycroft TRS (Ex. 96.1, eff. Jan 21, 2026) is an initial assessment outlining POX milling of sulfide/transition mineralization and heap leach of oxides; no reserves declared. CEO Diane R. Garrett. Debt-free balance sheet; cash and equivalents $181.7M at YE2025. 2025-2026 drill program: ~26,000 m core on high-grade silver systems + 8,200 m RC on heap-leach targets. 2025 net loss $40.7M.
mines.processing: Planned: crushing/grinding/flotation, pressure oxidation + cyanide leach for sulfides; heap leach for oxides

notes: FY2025 Form 10-K filed March 3, 2026. Exploration-stage gold-silver issuer with a single property, the Hycroft Mine (Nevada). No mineral reserves; resources per 2026 Hycroft TRS (prices $3,100/oz Au, $36.00/oz Ag) supersede the 2023 TRS. 2025-2026 drill program targeting high-grade silver systems (Vortex).

reserves_resources.notes: 1,530.279 Mt; oxide + transition + sulfide; 2026 Hycroft TRS initial assessment. Metal prices $3,100/oz Au, $36.00/oz Ag.
